{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

Parameter sweeps for cell and gene filtering thresholds.
Work here before committing threshold changes to `metadata/project_config.yaml`.

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(targets)
library(ggalluvial)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))
```

```{r load}
targets::tar_load(qc_params)
targets::tar_load(metadata_flagged_all)
targets::tar_load(rp_genes)
targets::tar_load(hb_genes)
SUBSET_NAMES <- c("stroma", "hsc", "mnc")
```

```{r qc-meta}
df         <- metadata_flagged_all
df_margins <- df %>% mutate(sample.name = "All")
df_plot    <- bind_rows(df, df_margins)

pct_bars <- function(feature) {
  df_plot |>
    dplyr::group_by(sample.name) |>
    dplyr::summarise(p5  = quantile(.data[[feature]], 0.05),
                     p95 = quantile(.data[[feature]], 0.95),
                     .groups = "drop")
}
errorbar_layer <- function(pct_df) {
  geom_errorbar(data = pct_df,
                aes(x = sample.name, ymin = p5, ymax = p95),
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8)
}
```

---

## 1. Distributions per sample {.tabset}

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Gene count (nFeature_RNA)

The number of genes per cell across all samples shows a clear compartment-specific pattern. Stromal cells tend to have lower number of genes, while HSCs have higher numbers, and MNCs are somewhere in-between. That said, the stromal samples have unexpectedly high number of cells with low number of features that go below the range of commonly used cutoffs.

```{r feat-hist, fig.height=8}
ggplot(df_plot, aes(sample.name, nFeature_RNA)) +
    geom_jitter(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.05) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.9) +
    errorbar_layer(pct_bars("nFeature_RNA")) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = 'Distribution of genes detected per cell',
         subtitle = "Black bars: 5th–95th percentile",
         y = "Number of features (n)",
         x = "Sample") +
    hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum() +
    theme(
        axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.title.y  = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        strip.text.x  = element_text(size = 8)
    )
```

## Mitochondrial %

The compartment-specific pattern can also be observed in the percentage of mitochondrial transcripts per cell. HSC samples show a consistent higher mitochondrial content compared to other samples, while large number of MNC cells show a strong pattern of mitochondrial depletion.

```{r mt-hist, fig.height=8}
ggplot(df_plot, aes(sample.name, percent.mt)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.9) +
  errorbar_layer(pct_bars("percent.mt")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = 'Distribution of mitochondrial content per cell',
       subtitle = "Black bars: 5th–95th percentile",
       y = "Mitochondrial content (%)",
       x = "Sample") +
  hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.y  = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    strip.text.x  = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```

## Ribosomal %

Genes identified (pattern `^Rp[sl]`): `r paste(rp_genes, collapse = ", ")`.

The percentage of reads mapping to ribosomal proteins differs dramatically between the compartments. MNCs and stromal samples are much lower than the expected 10x range, while HSCs are within range.

```{r rp-hist, fig.height=8}
ggplot(df_plot, aes(sample.name, percent.rp)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.9) +
  errorbar_layer(pct_bars("percent.rp")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = 'Distribution of ribosomal protein content per cell',
       subtitle = "Black bars: 5th–95th percentile",
       y = "Ribosomal protein content (%)",

    axis.title.y  = element_text(size = 15),

    axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    strip.text.x  = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```

## 2.5 Doublet / multiplet overlap

Comparison of HTO-based demultiplexing (deMULTIplex2) with transcription-based doublet detection (scDblFinder). There is strong agreement between singlets and `pass` cells, but multiplet and transcriptional doublet calls do not strongly overlap.

```{r doublet-table, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
tbl <- as.data.frame(table(scDblFinder  = df_plot$scDblFinder.class,
                            deMULTIplex2 = df_plot$dm2_class))
ggplot(tbl, aes(x = deMULTIplex2, y = scDblFinder, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(Freq)), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1, name = "Cells") +
  labs(title = "Doublet / multiplet overlap",
       x = "Demultiplexing class", y = "scDblFinder class") +
  hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum() +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15))
```

## 3. Threshold sweep {.tabset}

Vary each threshold independently while holding the others at config values.

```{r sweep-helper}
count_cells <- function(md,
                        mito_max  = qc_params$mito_percent_max,
                        feat_min  = 0,
                        feat_max  = Inf,
                        ribo_min  = 0,
                        ribo_max  = 100,
                        hb_max    = qc_params$hb_percent_max) {
  sum(md$percent.mt   <= mito_max &
      md$nFeature_RNA >= feat_min  &
      md$nFeature_RNA <= feat_max  &
      md$percent.rp   >= ribo_min  &
      md$percent.rp   <= ribo_max  &
      md$percent.hb   <= hb_max)
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r sweep-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 12

mito_grid <- c(10, 15, 20, 25, 30)
feat_grid <- list(
  list(min = 200, max = 5000), list(min = 300, max = 5000),
  list(min = 500, max = 5000), list(min = 500, max = 6000),
  list(min = 500, max = 7000), list(min = 700, max = 6000)
)
ribo_grid <- list(
  list(min = 0,  max = 40), list(min = 0,  max = 50),
  list(min = 0,  max = 60), list(min = 5,  max = 60),
  list(min = 10, max = 60)
)

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  targets::tar_load_raw(paste0("mpn_raw_", nm))
  srt     <- get(paste0("mpn_raw_", nm))
  md      <- srt@meta.data
  n_total <- nrow(md)
  cat("\n\n### ", toupper(nm), "\n\n")

  # mito sweep
  mito_df <- data.frame(
    mito_max     = mito_grid,
    n_cells      = sapply(mito_grid, function(x) count_cells(md, mito_max = x)),
    pct_retained = NA_real_
  )
  mito_df$pct_retained <- round(100 * mito_df$n_cells / n_total, 1)

  p_mito <- ggplot(mito_df, aes(x = mito_max, y = pct_retained)) +
    geom_line() + geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = qc_params$mito_percent_max,
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "firebrick") +
    labs(title = paste0(toupper(nm), " — mito_percent_max sweep"),
         subtitle = paste0("Dashed = current config (", qc_params$mito_percent_max, "%)"),
         x = "mito_percent_max", y = "% cells retained") +
    theme_bw()

  # nFeature sweep
  feat_rows <- list()
  for (g in feat_grid) {
    feat_rows[[length(feat_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      feat_min = g$min,
      feat_max = g$max,
      n_cells  = count_cells(md, feat_min = g$min, feat_max = g$max)
    )
  }
  feat_df <- do.call(rbind, feat_rows)
  rm(feat_rows)
  feat_df$pct_retained <- round(100 * feat_df$n_cells / n_total, 1)
  feat_df$label        <- paste0("[", feat_df$feat_min, ", ", feat_df$feat_max, "]")

  p_feat <- ggplot(feat_df, aes(x = label, y = pct_retained)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = count_cells(md) / n_total * 100,
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "firebrick") +
    labs(title = paste0(toupper(nm), " — nFeature sweep"),
         subtitle = "Dashed = current config",
         x = "[min, max]", y = "% cells retained") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

  # ribo sweep
  ribo_rows <- list()
  for (g in ribo_grid) {
    ribo_rows[[length(ribo_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      ribo_min = g$min,
      ribo_max = g$max,
      n_cells  = count_cells(md, ribo_min = g$min, ribo_max = g$max)
    )
  }
  ribo_df <- do.call(rbind, ribo_rows)
  rm(ribo_rows)
  ribo_df$pct_retained <- round(100 * ribo_df$n_cells / n_total, 1)
  ribo_df$label        <- paste0("[", ribo_df$ribo_min, ", ", ribo_df$ribo_max, "]")

  p_ribo <- ggplot(ribo_df, aes(x = label, y = pct_retained)) +
    geom_col(fill = "darkorange", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = count_cells(md) / n_total * 100,
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "firebrick") +
    labs(title = paste0(toupper(nm), " — ribo % sweep"),
         subtitle = "Dashed = current config",
         x = "[ribo_min, ribo_max]", y = "% cells retained") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

  print(p_mito / p_feat / p_ribo)

  rm(list = paste0("mpn_raw_", nm), srt, md); gc()
}
```

:::

## 4. Chosen thresholds — preview {.tabset}

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r preview-filter-tabs}
#| results: asis

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  targets::tar_load_raw(paste0("mpn_raw_", nm))
  srt     <- get(paste0("mpn_raw_", nm))
  md      <- srt@meta.data |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cell")
  n_total <- nrow(md)
  cat("\n\n### ", toupper(nm), "\n\n")

  n_pass <- sum(srt@meta.data$pass_qc)
  message(toupper(nm), " — Cells retained: ", n_pass, " / ", n_total,
          " (", round(100 * n_pass / n_total, 1), "%)")

  per_sample_qc <- md |>
    dplyr::group_by(sample.name) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_before       = dplyr::n(),
      lost_mito      = sum(!pass_mt),
      lost_feat_low  = sum(pass_mt & !pass_nFeature & nFeature_RNA < median(nFeature_RNA)),
      lost_feat_high = sum(pass_mt & !pass_nFeature & nFeature_RNA >= median(nFeature_RNA)),
      lost_ribo_low  = sum(!pass_rp & percent.rp < median(percent.rp)),
      lost_ribo_high = sum(!pass_rp & percent.rp >= median(percent.rp)),
      lost_hb        = sum(!pass_hb),
      n_after        = sum(pass_qc),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(n_lost       = n_before - n_after,
                  pct_retained = round(100 * n_after / n_before, 1)) |>
    dplyr::rename(sample = sample.name)

  print(knitr::kable(
    dplyr::select(per_sample_qc, sample, n_before, n_after, n_lost, pct_retained,
                  lost_mito, lost_feat_low, lost_feat_high,
                  lost_ribo_low, lost_ribo_high, lost_hb),
    col.names = c("Sample", "Before", "After", "Lost", "% Kept",
                  "↑ mito", "↓ feat", "↑ feat", "↓ ribo", "↑ ribo", "↑ hb"),
    align   = "lrrrrrrrrrr"
  ))

  rm(list = paste0("mpn_raw_", nm), srt, md); gc()
}
```

:::

## 5. QC flag alluvial {.tabset}

Each cell flows through the boolean QC flags in order: `pass_mt` → `pass_nFeature` →
`pass_rp` → `pass_hb` → `pass_hto` → `pass_dbl`.
Flow width = number of cells; colour = final `pass_cell` outcome (TRUE / FALSE).

```{r qc-alluvial-helper}
FLAG_COLS <- c("pass_mt", "pass_nFeature", "pass_rp", "pass_hb", "pass_hto", "pass_dbl")

qc_alluvial <- function(md, title) {
  af <- md[, c(FLAG_COLS, "pass_cell"), drop = FALSE]
  for (col in FLAG_COLS) {
    af[[col]] <- factor(ifelse(af[[col]], "pass", "fail"), levels = c("pass", "fail"))
  }
  af$pass_cell <- factor(ifelse(af$pass_cell, "pass_cell", "fail_cell"),
                         levels = c("pass_cell", "fail_cell"))

  agg <- af |>
    dplyr::count(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(FLAG_COLS, "pass_cell"))), name = "n")

  ggplot(agg,
         aes(axis1 = pass_mt, axis2 = pass_nFeature, axis3 = pass_rp,
             axis4 = pass_hb, axis5 = pass_hto,    axis6 = pass_dbl,
             y = n, fill = pass_cell)) +
    ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(alpha = 0.7, width = 1/8) +
    ggalluvial::geom_stratum(width = 1/8, fill = "grey85", colour = "grey40",
                             linewidth = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(stat = ggalluvial::StatStratum,
                       aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
                       size = 3, min.y = 50) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:6, labels = FLAG_COLS) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("pass_cell" = "#2ca25f", "fail_cell" = "#de2d26"),
      name   = "outcome"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, y = "cells") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
                   legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r qc-alluvial-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 7

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  targets::tar_load_raw(paste0("mpn_raw_", nm))
  srt    <- get(paste0("mpn_raw_", nm))
  md_sub <- srt@meta.data
  cat("\n\n### ", toupper(nm), "\n\n")

  cat("\n\n#### All samples\n\n")
  print(qc_alluvial(md_sub, paste0(toupper(nm), " — all samples")))

  for (samp in sort(unique(md_sub$sample.name))) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", samp, "\n\n")
    print(qc_alluvial(md_sub[md_sub$sample.name == samp, ],
                      paste0(samp, " — QC flag flow")))
  }

  rm(list = paste0("mpn_raw_", nm), srt, md_sub); gc()
}
```

:::

## 6. QC filter co-occurrence {.tabset}

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r qc-cooccurrence-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

qc_flags  <- c("pass_mt", "pass_nFeature", "pass_rp", "pass_hb", "pass_hto", "pass_dbl")
nice_names <- c(pass_mt = "Mito %", pass_nFeature = "nFeature",
                pass_rp = "Ribo %",  pass_hb = "Hb %",
                pass_hto = "HTO",    pass_dbl = "Doublet")

cooc_heatmap <- function(md, title) {
  flag_mat <- as.matrix(md[, qc_flags])
  n        <- length(qc_flags)
  cooc     <- matrix(0L, n, n, dimnames = list(qc_flags, qc_flags))
  for (i in seq_len(n))
    for (j in seq_len(n))
      cooc[i, j] <- sum(!flag_mat[, i] & !flag_mat[, j])
  long <- reshape2::melt(cooc, varnames = c("metric_x", "metric_y"), value.name = "n_cells")
  long$metric_x <- factor(nice_names[as.character(long$metric_x)], levels = nice_names)
  long$metric_y <- factor(nice_names[as.character(long$metric_y)], levels = rev(nice_names))

  ggplot(long, aes(metric_x, metric_y, fill = n_cells)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_cells,
                  colour = n_cells > max(n_cells) * 0.5), size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = "grey20"), guide = "none") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f7fbff", high = "#08519c",
                        name = "Cells failing\nboth metrics") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.position = "right")
}

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  targets::tar_load_raw(paste0("mpn_raw_", nm))
  srt <- get(paste0("mpn_raw_", nm))
  cat("\n\n### ", toupper(nm), "\n\n")
  print(cooc_heatmap(srt@meta.data, paste0(toupper(nm), " — QC filter co-occurrence")))
  rm(list = paste0("mpn_raw_", nm), srt); gc()
}
```

---

## 7. QC metrics on PCA / UMAP {.tabset}

QC metrics projected onto the dimensionality reductions of each processed subset.

```{r load-processed}
targets::tar_load(proc_params)

PCA_NAME   <- paste0("pca.", proc_params$ref_assay)
QC_METRICS <- c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt",
                "percent.rp",   "percent.hb", "S.Score", "G2M.Score")
```

```{r qc-embedding-helper}
extract_emb <- function(srt) {
  md   <- srt@meta.data[, intersect(QC_METRICS, colnames(srt@meta.data)), drop = FALSE]
  pca  <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(srt, PCA_NAME)[, 1:2])
  umap <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(srt,
           grep("^umap\\.", names(srt@reductions), value = TRUE)[1])[, 1:2])
  colnames(pca)  <- c("Dim1", "Dim2")
  colnames(umap) <- c("Dim1", "Dim2")
  list(pca  = cbind(pca,  md),
       umap = cbind(umap, md))
}

plot_qc_emb <- function(df, metric, title, n_max = 50000L) {
  if (nrow(df) > n_max) df <- df[sample(nrow(df), n_max), ]
  ggplot(df[order(df[[metric]]), ],
         aes(x = Dim1, y = Dim2, colour = .data[[metric]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = metric) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 9) +
    theme(legend.position  = "right",
          legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
          plot.title       = element_text(size = 8))
}

plot_qc_reduction <- function(emb_df, reduction_label, subset_label) {
  avail <- intersect(QC_METRICS, colnames(emb_df))
  plots <- list()
  for (m in avail) {
    plots[[m]] <- plot_qc_emb(emb_df, m,
                              title = paste0(m, " — ", subset_label, " (", reduction_label, ")"))
  }
  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = min(3L, length(avail)))
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r qc-pca-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

PROCESSED_NAMES <- c("stroma", "hsc", "mnc")

for (nm in PROCESSED_NAMES) {
  targets::tar_load_raw(paste0("mpn_processed_", nm))
  srt <- get(paste0("mpn_processed_", nm))
  emb <- extract_emb(srt)
  rm(list = paste0("mpn_processed_", nm), srt); gc()

  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")
  cat("\n\n#### PCA\n\n")
  print(plot_qc_reduction(emb$pca,  "PCA",  nm))
  cat("\n\n#### UMAP\n\n")
  print(plot_qc_reduction(emb$umap, "UMAP", nm))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
